description: This Java source file defines an abstract actor class for persistence operations within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages subscriptions to namespace and entity purge commands via Akka pub-sub, handles purge requests, and manages resource cleanup.

classes.name: AbstractPersistenceOperationsActor
classes.description: An abstract Akka actor class for handling namespace and entity persistence operations, including subscribing to purge commands, executing purges, and resource management.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Initializes subscriptions for namespace and entity commands when the actor starts.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Cleans up resources by closing closeable objects when the actor stops.

methods.name: subscribeForNamespaceCommands
methods.description: Subscribes to namespace purge commands via pub-sub.

methods.name: subscribeForEntitiesCommands
methods.description: Subscribes to entity purge commands via pub-sub.

methods.name: getSubscribeGroup
methods.description: Returns the subscription group identifier based on actor path.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling for purge commands and subscription acknowledgments.

methods.name: purgeNamespace
methods.description: Handles namespace purge requests, invoking namespaceOps.purge and responding with success or failure.

methods.name: purgeEntities
methods.description: Handles entity purge requests, initiating shutdown of persistence actors and scheduling entity purging.

methods.name: shutDownPersistenceActorsOfEntitiesToPurge
methods.description: Publishes shutdown commands for persistence actors related to entities to be purged.

methods.name: schedulePurgingEntitiesIn
methods.description: Schedules the actual entity purge after a delay.

methods.name: doPurgeEntities
methods.description: Performs the entity purge operation and responds with success or failure.
